title: 空白
summary: 空状态不要一律「暂无数据 + 一个按钮」。先判断为什么空：创建给入口，搜索改关键词，筛选改条件，失败可重试并保留原列表，完成给反馈不要再催。
summaryEn: Do not make every blank “no data + a button”. Name the cause first: create gets an entry, search revises the query, filters loosen, failure retries and keeps the list, done only celebrates.
asks: 空白为什么空，该给入口、改关键词、改条件、重试，还是只给完成反馈？
asksEn: Why is this blank — should it offer create, revise the query, loosen filters, retry, or only celebrate?

links.when: 为什么空不是屏幕上该留骨架还是空
links.whenEn: why it is empty is not whether a skeleton or an empty state occupies the screen
an empty state is not a toast

links.when: 加载失败可重试不是进度条
links.whenEn: a failed load with retry is not a progress bar
